# SunoSathi (सुनोसाथी)

> SunoSathi gives deaf and hard-of-hearing people in India a real phone
> number with live captions. When someone calls it, the user reads the
> caller's words as live subtitles — in Hindi, Gujarati, English or
> Hinglish, auto-detected — and replies with their own voice. The caller
> needs no app: they dial a normal number and talk normally.

## Key facts
- Audience: 63 million deaf and hard-of-hearing Indians
- Languages: Hindi, Gujarati, English, Hinglish (auto-detected per utterance);
  unidentifiable speech is captioned phonetically in Latin letters
- Captions arrive in under a second at natural speech pauses
- Outbound calls to any number are supported; the callee hears the user's real voice
- Every call is saved as transcript + audio for the user; caption accuracy is
  automatically measured after each call
- Speech-to-text: Sarvam AI (saaras v3); pluggable providers (Deepgram, Google)
- Status: free public pilot (2026); join at https://sunosathi.com/#pilot
- Built at the GrowthX buildathon; born from a LinkedIn build-in-public post
